description: This file is a script for managing GitHub security advisories related to vulnerabilities in npm packages, specifically for the openclaw package. It offers command-line functionality for creating and updating advisory entries, parsing arguments, executing GitHub CLI commands, and handling vulnerability details.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Outputs usage instructions for the script.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Prints an error message and terminates the process.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments into an object.

methods.name: runGh
methods.description: Executes a gitHub CLI command synchronously and returns the stdout.

methods.name: deriveRepoFromOrigin
methods.description: Derives the repository name from the git remote origin URL.

methods.name: parseGhsaId
methods.description: Extracts the GHSA ID from the provided argument.

methods.name: writeTempJson
methods.description: Creates a temporary JSON file with the given data and returns its path.
